title: Curved and Head-Up Displays
summary: Feedback on the F70’s display systems centers on appreciation for the curved and head-up displays, alongside complaints about the missing head-up display and some dissatisfaction with console or driver display usability.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the curved display’s appearance and visibility, the head-up display, and the console display for navigation and driver information.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on disappointment that the head-up display is absent and on dislike or frustration with the console or broader technical display setup.

mixed.summary: The mixed review mentions having a head-up display like the previous car without enough detail to identify a clear benefit or drawback.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the curved, control, or driver displays with unclear sentiment or with too little context to classify confidently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined or very short, which limits confidence about specific display likes and dislikes.
This topic mixes several related but distinct display elements, including the curved display, head-up display, control display, console display, and driver display.
Examples are stratified samples and do not represent the full population of reviews.
